findings.description: Nested-within-nested repos could lose whole-cwd protection if discovery stopped at the first .git boundary.
findings.resolution: Plan now requires a complete initialized nested-root forest, parent-child skip semantics, and parent -> submodule -> child-submodule regression coverage.

findings.description: Index-only and mode-only nested repo mutations were not explicitly covered by a byte-content comparison plan.
findings.resolution: Plan now requires independent post-run index/mode comparison and tests for unstaging, restaging, partially staged reset, staged add/delete, and update-index chmod.

findings.description: Spill and budget design did not require stat-first reservation before reading large dirty/untracked files.
findings.resolution: Plan now requires lstat-before-read, budget reservation before capture, streaming spill outside cwd, narrow budget handling, and cleanup on clean/revert/signal/budget paths.

findings.description: No-whole-tree byte-capture validation could be too loose if it relied only on peak memory or aggregate stats.
findings.resolution: Plan now requires deterministic read-spy/test-hook instrumentation that fails on clean tracked large-submodule byte reads plus captured-byte stats limited to dirty/untracked paths.
